description:
Layout: arrange many objects at once by their bounds (children included): align, distribute, snap to a grid, drop to
the ground, rows / grids / circles, seeded jitter, and finding free space for something new.
Every tool that moves objects is one undo step; targets are node ids, node paths, actor:Name or object paths.
Workflow: create objects (build.*, actors.spawn_actor) -> arrange_in_row / arrange_in_grid / arrange_in_circle or
align_nodes / distribute_nodes -> drop_to_ground -> randomize_transform for a natural look. Use find_free_space before
placing something new in a crowded scene.
name: layout

tools.description:
Aligns the bounds (min, centre or max) of objects on one axis: to the selection's combined bounds, to another object's bounds, or to a coordinate. Undoable. Fails if targets is empty.
Returns: {moved, nodes, aligned_to}.

mode.description: Which bounds point to align: "min", "center" or "max".

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

to.description: Align to this object's bounds instead of the selection. (Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

value.description: Align to this coordinate (a number in cm) instead, e.g. 0 for the floor. (Any JSON value)

tools.name: layout.align_nodes

aligned_to.description: The coordinate everything was aligned to (cm).

tools.description:
Places objects evenly on a horizontal circle or arc (heights unchanged). A full circle spaces N objects N ways; a partial arc includes both ends. Undoable. Fails if radius is negative or arc is outside 1-360.
Returns: {moved, nodes}.

arc.description: Degrees covered, e.g. 180 for a half circle.

center.description: Circle centre [x,y,z] (default: the selection's centre). ([x, y, z] (cm))

start_angle.description: Angle of the first object in degrees (0 = +X).

targets.description: Objects in order around the circle.

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.arrange_in_circle

moved.description: Objects that actually moved (unchanged ones are skipped).

nodes.description: References of the moved objects (at most 50).

tools.description:
Places objects in a grid on the XY plane, row by row in the given order; each cell is the largest object plus the gap. Undoable. Fails if columns is negative.
Returns: {moved, nodes, columns, rows}.

columns.description: Columns per row (0 = as square as possible).

origin.description: Centre of the first cell [x,y,z] (default: the first object's centre). ([x, y, z] (cm))

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.arrange_in_grid

tools.description:
Lines objects up edge to edge along a direction, in the given order. Undoable. Fails if direction is zero.
Returns: {moved, nodes}.

start.description: Centre of the first object [x,y,z] (default: its current centre). ([x, y, z] (cm))

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.arrange_in_row

moved.description: Objects that actually moved (unchanged ones are skipped).

nodes.description: References of the moved objects (at most 50).

tools.description:
Spaces objects along an axis: even centres between the first and the last, or a fixed edge-to-edge gap starting at the first. Objects are ordered by their position on the axis. Undoable. Fails with fewer than 2 targets.
Returns: {moved, nodes}.

gap.description: Edge-to-edge gap in cm, e.g. 50 (negative = even centres between the first and the last).

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.distribute_nodes

moved.description: Objects that actually moved (unchanged ones are skipped).

nodes.description: References of the moved objects (at most 50).

tools.description:
Moves objects down (or up) until the bottom of their bounds rests on what is below their centre (Epic: snap_to_ground). Targets ignore each other. Undoable. Fails if max_distance is not positive.
Returns: {moved, nodes, no_ground} (no_ground: targets with nothing below them).

max_distance.description: How far down to look, in cm.

offset.description: Extra height above the ground in cm.

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.drop_to_ground

returnValue.description: {moved, nodes, no_ground} (no_ground: targets with nothing below them).

no_ground.description: Targets with nothing below them within max_distance (not moved).

returnValue.title: LayoutToolDropResult

tools.description:
Finds the nearest spot where a box of the given size fits without overlapping anything, searching a square spiral outward from a point (optionally resting on the ground). Read-only. Fails if size is not positive.
Returns: {found, center, ground_location, tested}.

near.description: Search from here [x,y,z] (default the origin). ([x, y, z] (cm))

on_ground.description: Rest the box on the ground (spots without ground are skipped).

step.description: Grid step in cm (0 = the box's larger horizontal size).

tools.name: layout.find_free_space

found.description: Whether a free spot was found within the radius.

tools.description:
Adds seeded random offset, yaw and uniform scale for a natural look; the same seed gives the same result. Undoable. Fails if scale_jitter is outside 0-0.95.
Returns: {moved, nodes}.

location_jitter.description: Maximum offset per axis [x,y,z] cm, e.g. [100,100,0]. ([x, y, z] (cm))

scale_jitter.description: Maximum uniform scale change as a fraction, e.g. 0.2.

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.randomize_transform

moved.description: Objects that actually moved (unchanged ones are skipped).

nodes.description: References of the moved objects (at most 50).

tools.description:
Snaps locations (X and Y, optionally Z) and optionally rotations to a grid. Undoable. Fails if size is not positive.
Returns: {moved, nodes}.

rotation_step.description: Rotation snap in degrees, e.g. 45 (0 = rotations unchanged).

items.description: Reference to Actor: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path

tools.name: layout.snap_to_grid

moved.description: Objects that actually moved (unchanged ones are skipped).

nodes.description: References of the moved objects (at most 50).
